items.teaser: Ukraine’s sanctions commissioner says Geran engines are on Beijing’s updated list and sees an opening for Kyiv.

items.title: Trump kündigt Treffen zwischen Selenskyj und Putin „bald“ an
items.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump erklärte vor Journalisten, ein Treffen zwischen dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj und dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin solle bald stattfinden.

items.title: Sorge vor Gewalt - Verfassungsschutz warnt vor Einfluss von Linksextremisten auf geplante Jugendproteste
items.teaser: Das Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz hat vor einer Instrumentalisierung der für Samstag geplanten Jugendproteste durch linksextremistische Gruppen gewarnt.

items.title: Russian forces strike Kharkiv, killing one and injuring three
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck Kharkiv’s Osnovianskyi district, killing one person and injuring three others.

items.title: Russian marketplace Ozon estimates losses from drone attacks on warehouses at over 30 billion rubles
items.teaser: Russian online marketplace Ozon has estimated its losses from drone attacks on its logistics facilities at 30.1 billion rubles.

items.title: In Region Tula brennt nach Drohnenangriff Chemiewerk „Azot“
items.teaser: In der Stadt Nowomoskowsk in der Region Tula ist das Werk der Nowomoskowsker Aktiengesellschaft „Azot“ nach dem Drohnenangriff in Brand geraten.

items.title: Ukraine's foreign intelligence chief warns that fake messages are being sent in his name to gain information on negotiations
items.teaser: Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence chief Rustem Umierov has said fake messages in his name are targeting diplomats to obtain information on peace negotiations.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in the Netherlands
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in the Netherlands for an official visit.

items.title: Zelenskyy arrives in Netherlands – video
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has begun an official visit to the Netherlands to discuss military support, economic cooperation, and joint security initiatives.

items.title: Three Russian air defense assets hit over past 24 hours, General Staff says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck three Russian air defense assets on Russian territory on October 27 and overnight into October 28. The targets included a Tor surface-to-air missile system, a radar station, and an electronic warfare system.

items.title: Wenige Tage vor Demonstration: "Gen Z regelt"-Unterstützer springen ab - versinkt der Protest im Chaos?
items.teaser: Der große Protesttag rückt näher: Für kommenden Samstag ruft die Organisation "Gen Z regelt" deutschlandweit zu Demonstrationen auf. Doch nun befürchten bisherige Unterstützer Chaos - und gehen auf Distanz. Auch der Verfassungsschutz ist besorgt.

items.title: Ukraine’s parliament approves 2027 state budget in first reading
items.teaser: With security and defense allocations accounting for around two-thirds of planned expenditure and a projected deficit of nearly Hr 1.7 trillion ($37 billion), the budget highlights the challenge of funding the war while maintaining economic stability and meeting social commitments.

items.title: Zelensky tasks PM with assembling Kyiv winter preparations team, says Klitschko 'can't do it alone'
items.teaser: "It would be wonderful if Kyiv could protect itself or at least prepare for the dangers. But that didn't happen in any of these areas," Zelensky said.

items.title: Ukraine’s indigenous ballistic missiles could put Russia’s best-defended targets at risk, Turkish expert says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s development and use of its own ballistic missiles will pose a greater challenge to Russia by making some of its best-protected targets vulnerable.

items.title: Bund lässt mehr Beschäftigte auf Sabotagerisiko prüfen
items.teaser: Stromnetz, Wasserwerke, LNG-Terminals: Der Bund will künftig Beschäftigte in noch mehr Betrieben daraufhin überprüfen lassen, ob sie anfällig dafür sind, als Innentäter den Betrieb zu sabotieren.

items.title: Ukraine paused attacks on oil refineries for 3 days as Russia continued strikes on energy infrastructure, Zelensky says
items.teaser: During those days, Ukrainian forces acted "a little more cautiously," but were not ordered to refrain from responding to Russian strikes, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: One killed and three injured in Russian drone strike on Kharkiv
items.teaser: A 60-year-old man was killed and three other men were injured when Russian forces struck Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district with an attack drone on 28 October.

items.title: A Russian cruise missile that doesn’t match its name fell almost intact in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: A box-shaped body, a V-tail, composite skin: Ukrainian specialists can now study Russia’s new design up close.

items.title: "Gen-Z"-Proteste: Verfassungsschutz warnt vor linksextremen Einflüssen
items.teaser: In Hamburg und anderen Städten wollen am Samstag Jugendliche für bessere Bildung protestieren. Verfassungsschutz und Polizei beobachten die Lage genau.

items.title: 2027 State Budget draft approved in first reading
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada has approved the draft law on Ukraine’s 2027 state budget in the first reading, with 239 lawmakers voting in favor.

items.title: Zelensky lands in Netherlands to discuss air defense, economic partnership
items.teaser: "We will discuss defense and economic cooperation, strengthening Ukrainian air defense, and new steps to support Ukraine," Zelensky said on X upon his arrival.

items.title: A warehouse by day, homes by night: Russian jet drones keep hitting Kharkiv
items.teaser: Five people were hurt, a 4-year-old among them, and the next day a Russian drone hit the same district again, killing one person and injuring two.

items.title: Canadian volunteer, who rescued hundreds of animals, killed in Russian drone strike in Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Canadian volunteer Jesse Adams, who rescued animals and helped people in Ukraine, has been killed by a Russian drone strike while evacuating animals in Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Selenskyj: Abschaltung von Starlink/Starshield ist einer der Gründe für zivile Todesopfer bei Angriffen
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute vor Journalisten, die Verlangsamung des Betriebs der Starlink/Starshield-Satellitendienste sei einer der Gründe für zivile Todesopfer bei russischen Luftangriffen. Er fügte hinzu, er wisse nicht, wer den Befehl zur Drosselung des Betriebs dieser Dienste gegeben habe.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russia is building drone launch site near Millerovo to launch up to 100 Geran UAVs a day, Ukrainian intelligence says – photos
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says satellite images show a new Geran-4 and Geran-5 launch site near Millerovo airfield, built in about two months.

items.title: Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau rejects fugitive prosecutor general Kravchenko's allegations
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) has rejected former prosecutor general Ruslan Kravchenko's claims that it was involved in a plot to carry out "violent acts" against him, describing them as an attempt to obtain protection abroad.

items.title: Netherlands to provide Ukraine with €1.2B in non-military aid over three years
items.teaser: The Dutch government will provide Ukraine with €1.2 billion in non-military assistance over the next three years. The funding will primarily support the energy and water supply sectors, Ukraine’s recovery and reconstruction, and cooperation between Ukrainian and Dutch businesses.

items.title: Ukrainian monitors report fire near Russian plant that sold steel to an S-400 missile builder
items.teaser: Lipetsk’s governor denies any large industrial fire, saying drone debris set a tree belt alight.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike three Russian air defence assets
items.teaser: The General Staff says Ukrainian forces struck a Tor-M2 system, a radar and an electronic warfare station in Russia, plus a supply depot in occupied Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Russian forces step up assaults on Huliaipole axis, National Guard says
items.teaser: Russian forces have stepped up assaults on the Huliaipole axis in recent days. Meanwhile, the highest number of combat engagements has been reported on the Pokrovsk axis, with heavy fighting also reported on the Ocheretyne and Kostiantynivka axes.

items.title: 2 Russian army deserters arrested while heading for Kyiv
items.teaser: Both were detained when trying to cross into Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, and one "was found to be wearing a Russian military identification tag around his neck," SBU said.

items.title: Nearly 50 companies involved in producing Russia's Starlink alternative, 23 not under international sanctions, HUR says
items.teaser: Rassvet's planned coverage is expected to focus primarily on Ukraine and Europe, HUR said, warning that the system could also support Russian hybrid operations against other countries.

items.title: 16 Suspects detained in major stolen drones scheme
items.teaser: Law enforcement officials have uncovered a large-scale scheme in which drones were allegedly stolen from military units, had their markings altered, and were resold to the military as new, according to investigators.

items.title: An der Front 191 Stürme gemeldet, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: An der Front kam es am vergangenen Tag, dem 27. Oktober, zu 191 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Streitkräften und den russischen Besatzern, ließ auf Facebook der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte zur Lage an der Front am Mittwoch, dem 28. Oktober, melden.

items.title: Fugitive prosecutor general Kravchenko accuses Ukraine of plotting "violent acts" against him, stays silent on why he has not returned
items.teaser: Former Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko accuses NABU, SAPO and the President’s Office of planning “violent acts” against him, but does not explain why he has not returned to Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian MP elected president of OSCE Parliamentary Assembly
items.teaser: Mykyta Poturaiev, Chair of the Verkhovna Rada Committee on Humanitarian and Information Policy, has been elected president of the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly.

items.title: Vor israelischer Botschaft: Anschlag in Serbien - Minderjähriger attackiert Polizisten
items.teaser: Höchste Terrorwarnstufe in Serbien: Kurz nach Mitternacht greift ein junger Serbe einen Polizisten in Belgrad an - dabei soll er "Allahu akbar!" gerufen haben. Der mutmaßlich Minderjährige ist den Behörden bereits bekannt.

items.title: Ukraine has found a way to respond to Russian attacks on data centers, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Ukraine has found a way to respond to Russian attacks on data centers and cyberspace, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

items.title: Ukrainian forces report no further Russian infiltration into Kupiansk after Operation Veles
items.teaser: Joint Forces Group spokesman Viktor Trehubov said Russian troops, who infiltrated northern Kupiansk via a pipeline, have not been seen entering since Operation Veles.

items.title: Press officer with Ukraine's Borysfen Brigade killed in Kherson
items.teaser: Volodymyr Obertas, a press officer with the Borysfen Brigade, has been killed in Kherson. He was a native of Oleshky, a city currently occupied by Russian forces.

items.title: Serbien: Höchste Terrorwarnstufe nach Anschlag vor israelischer Botschaft
items.teaser: Erneut wird ein Wachbeamter vor der israelischen Botschaft in Belgrad angegriffen. Der Vorfall weckt Erinnerungen – welche Sicherheitsmaßnahmen Serbien jetzt ergreift.

items.title: Ukraine receives 12 Patriot missiles per month from US, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Ukraine needs to intercept around 150 Russian ballistic missiles per month but receives about 150 Patriot missiles from the U.S. annually, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Netherlands confirms $1.3 billion in non-military aid for Ukraine through 2029
items.teaser: "Support for recovery and reconstruction can't wait for a ceasefire. Ukraine needs our help right now: military support, but also social and economic assistance," Dutch Foreign Trade Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma said during his visit to Kyiv.

items.title: Trump says Zelensky and Putin will meet “very soon”
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that a meeting between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Russian leader Vladimir Putin is expected to take place soon.

items.title: Luftabwehr schießt ab/neutralisiert 71 russische Kamikaze-Drohnen
items.teaser: Die Luftverteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben 71 russische Angriffsdrohnen neutralisiert, ließ die Luftwaffe der Streitkräfte der Ukraine im Online-Dienst Telegram melden.

items.title: Russia in Africa: What is Putin hoping to achieve?
items.teaser: Following its invasion of Ukraine and the resulting rift with the West, Russia has declared that it intends to make a "historic return" to Africa. What have we seen of this so far?

items.title: Netherlands to provide Ukraine with over €1bn in non-military aid
items.teaser: The Netherlands will provide Ukraine with €1.2 billion in non-military aid over the next three years to support recovery and reconstruction and to create opportunities for Dutch businesses.

items.title: Zelensky: All forms of diplomacy must be used to defend Ukraine
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky states that all forms of diplomacy must be used to defend Ukraine.

items.title: Zelenskyy to meet Dutch PM and King Willem-Alexander on 28 October
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president will meet with Dutch government officials, business leaders and King Willem-Alexander to discuss defence and bilateral cooperation.

items.title: Poll: 80% of Ukrainians support strikes on Russian oil refineries, even if US cuts aid
items.teaser: A new KIIS poll has revealed strong public backing for strikes on Russian oil refineries and highlights that 63% of citizens are willing to endure the war in the long term.

items.title: In diesem Jahr erhält Ukraine durchschnittlich nur zwölf Raketen pro Monat für Patriot-Systeme – Selenskyj
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute vor Journalisten, dass die Ukraine in diesem Jahr durchschnittlich nur zwölf Raketen pro Monat für die Patriot-Systeme erhält.

items.title: Ceasefire in Oleshky enters 30th hour as Russian strikes kill 2, injure 17 elsewhere in Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces launched an Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missile and 88 Shahed-type drones at Ukraine, including 38 jet-powered drones, overnight on Oct. 28.

items.title: Zelenskyy on his rhetoric towards Trump: No time for quiet signals
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy explains his direct rhetoric towards Donald Trump, saying Ukraine has no time for ‘quiet signals’ amid Russian attacks and a shortage of anti-ballistic missiles

items.title: Zelensky: Russia appears serious about Abu Dhabi meeting
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that following the conversation between European leaders and Russian President Putin, there is a sense that Russia is seriously committed to the meeting of the negotiating teams in Abu Dhabi, during which they plan to discuss the first steps toward de-escalation in the energy sector

items.title: Zelensky backs Norway-Finland talks with Putin, says Trump already ended Russia's isolation
items.teaser: Zelensky praised Norway and Finland for putting their diplomacy "completely out in the open: discussions in advance, a full briefing, and transparent objectives," saying that not all countries had taken the time to speak with Ukraine beforehand.

items.title: When Does a Tribunal’s Reasoning Become a Breach of the Right to Be Heard? Lessons from Singapore
items.teaser: How far may an arbitral tribunal go beyond the reasoning advanced by the parties without violating the parties’ right to be heard? items.title: Russen töten zwei und verletzen drei Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 27. Oktober töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk zwei Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Zelenskyy says diesel deal could mark start of further Russia-US agreements
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has noted that the diesel arrangement could lead to broader discussions on frozen assets, energy resources and the lifting of sanctions on Russian entities.

items.title: Zelenskyy says he has no alternative to peace negotiating group, but is open to proposals
items.teaser: While acknowledging various opinions from experienced politicians, Zelenskyy has emphasised that his current delegation continues its vital diplomatic work

items.title: Zelensky pushes back against Musk, says Ukraine uses Starshield to defend itself
items.teaser: "When Elon Musk said that we use Starshield against the Russians — yes, against the Russians, but on our own territory. This is not offensive; it’s defensive," Zelensky told journalists at a press briefing.

items.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Trump kündigt "sehr bald" ein Treffen an
items.teaser: Zwischen den USA, Russland und der Ukraine könnte es bald zu neuen Verhandlungen kommen. US-Präsident Donald Trump zeigt sich zuversichtlich.
